Just created these EPIC white dragon shots with @ImagineArt_X using Seedance 1.5 Pro!

Hyper-realistic, slowly emerging from thick mist in ancient ruins… the details, rain, atmosphere and sheer scale are next-level 🔥

Started with the images, then turned them into cinematic videos with synchronized audio in seconds. Best part? I can easily edit, generate variations, or upscale the videos right inside the app. Game-changer for fantasy creators!

Who else is making legendary creatures with Seedance 1.5 Pro?
